A variety of goods and services are available here, since local imports make their way to the other parts of Kaineng from here. The [[Am Fah]] have made inroads from [[the Undercity]] into this area and control much of the southern roads and alleys, much to the annoyance of the [[Jade Brotherhood]] whose [[Jade Brotherhood's guild hall|guild hall]] is on the island in the northwest. == Getting there == [[Factions]] characters will first go through this area during the [[primary quest]] [[A Master's Burden]]. Characters from other [[campaign]]s will find it easiest to come here via [[the Marketplace]]. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: * [[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]] narrow pathways to the southeast and the cliffside path in the west. *** With ''Seek Out Brother Tosai'' active, you can also avoid killing any mantids: enter from [[The Marketplace]] and target only the [[Jade Brotherhood]] in the north. *** There is a hidden Jade Brotherhood group near both the central and western bridges of the northern island. {{Anomaly|Some players have reported problems with the kills-counter for vanquishing in this area under some narrow circumstances. If the player kills the mantids first, the counter might show 90% completion even though there are up to 200 more non-[[popup]] foes remaining.
